question: I would like to know the given names of baseball players who have achieved the highest value of games played, runs, hits, and home runs, with their corresponding score values.
sql: WITH career_stats AS (SELECT player_id, TRY_CAST(SUM(TRY_CAST(g AS DOUBLE)) AS BIGINT) as total_g, TRY_CAST(SUM(TRY_CAST(r AS DOUBLE)) AS BIGINT) as total_r, TRY_CAST(SUM(TRY_CAST(h AS DOUBLE)) AS BIGINT) as total_h, TRY_CAST(SUM(TRY_CAST(hr AS DOUBLE)) AS BIGINT) as total_hr FROM batting WHERE TRY_CAST(g AS DOUBLE) IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player_id), leaders AS (SELECT 'games_played' as category, player_id, total_g as value FROM career_stats QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_g DESC) = 1 UNION ALL SELECT 'runs', player_id, total_r FROM career_stats QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_r DESC) = 1 UNION ALL SELECT 'hits', player_id, total_h FROM career_stats QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_h DESC) = 1 UNION ALL SELECT 'home_runs', player_id, total_hr FROM career_stats QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_hr DESC) = 1) SELECT l.category, p.name_given, l.value FROM leaders l JOIN player p ON l.player_id = p.player_id ORDER BY l.category
